title: Robustness of H1 (event short x0.5 when BTC 30-day vol is above its 1-year median) - FLAGGED post hoc
why: H1 passed its rule (+0.096, every period up) but the regime effect was seen in the Gen473 table first. A post-hoc rule that only works at one setting is a selection artefact; a real effect should hold for neighbouring settings and inside every period.
checks: per cell: book Sharpe and periods 2022 / 2023-24 / 2025-26 vs v9.8 (same code as H1: results/v98_paper_sleeves.parquet, portfolio_v5)
event-short sleeve alone: Sharpe in high- vs low-vol days per period (30-day window, median)
robust_if: at least 10 of 12 cells pass (+0.05 and no period lower) AND the median gain >= 0.05 AND the sleeve is weaker in high-vol days in all three periods
decision: robust -> propose as a v9.9 candidate component (user decides; forward evidence from the existing shadow account v98:event_vol_regime); not robust -> drop H1
promotion: never without the user's explicit OK; v9.8 stays frozen
